name: Finnegan
message: Milady's consorting with the nobles again.

name: Richard
message: Think she relates to them better'n us salty old sharks?

name: Finnegan
message: Dunnah. I think she ought've killed 'em all on the spot.

name: Richard
message: She's still blue-blooded in 'er heart, no matter what she says. She's loyal to her first husband's family.

name: Finnegan
message: Lady O'Flaherty! May Donal rest in peace. If only he could see what she's doin' these days...

name: Richard
message: Old Donal would be in for a shock, that's for sure. He loved 'is sweet, bonny wife. But that wife is gone. The Pirate Queen took 'er place.
